description: This file implements the methods for the PoolAllocator and Allocation classes, which are part of a custom memory pooling system used in the ANGLE project. It includes memory management, guard block checking, and allocation/deallocation logic.

classes.name: PoolAllocator
classes.description: A custom memory pool allocator managing fixed-size memory pages and allocations.

classes.name: Allocation
classes.description: Represents individual memory allocations within the pool, with guard block checking.

methods.name: PoolAllocator::PoolAllocator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the pool allocator with growth increment and alignment.

methods.name: PoolAllocator::~PoolAllocator
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up allocated memory pages and resources.

methods.name: PoolAllocator::push
methods.description: Saves current allocation state for potential rollback.

methods.name: PoolAllocator::pop
methods.description: Restores previous allocation state, freeing allocations made after the last push.

methods.name: PoolAllocator::popAll
methods.description: Deallocates all allocations made in the pool.

methods.name: PoolAllocator::allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory of specified size from the pool, handling page management.

methods.name: PoolAllocator::allocateNewPage
methods.description: Allocates a new memory page for the pool when needed.

methods.name: PoolAllocator::lock
methods.description: Locks the allocator to prevent concurrent modifications.

methods.name: Allocation::checkGuardBlock
methods.description: Checks a guard block for memory damage.

methods.name: Allocation::checkAllocList
methods.description: Checks all allocations in a list for memory damage.
